_about: Chip materials. A layer's 'material' in a chip spec matches a material here by id or alias. max_working_temp_c values are typical datasheet values, marked as assumptions until checked against the exact sheet or resin we use. chemical_compatibility is 'compatible', 'limited', 'incompatible' or 'TODO'; tools/check_chip_spec.py warns on every reagent a protocol uses that is TODO or incompatible.

pmma.name: PMMA (acrylic)
pmma.optical_transparency: Optically clear, ~92% visible transmission; moderate autofluorescence
pmma.pcr_98c_status: DISQUALIFIED for the PCR chip: Tg ~105 C, heat deflection ~95-100 C, so it deforms at the 98 C hold
pmma.dna_adsorption: Moderate: DNA and proteins adsorb unless the surface is treated (ASSUMPTION)
pmma.note: DISQUALIFIED for the PCR chip (Tg ~105 C, heat deflection ~95-100 C); fine for 37 C culture chips. Typical maximum continuous service temperature for PMMA is roughly 65-90 C depending on grade. Stress-crazes in alcohols (80% ethanol, isopropanol) under load, so those need checking before verdicts are filled in. Confirm with the supplier datasheet.

printed_resin.name: 3D-printed photopolymer resin
printed_resin.optical_transparency: Clear grades are translucent to slightly hazy and yellow with age; not a reliable optical window (ASSUMPTION)
printed_resin.pcr_98c_status: DISQUALIFIED for the PCR chip: general-purpose resin softens at ~73 C, AND every SLA resin tested inhibits PCR
printed_resin.note: DISQUALIFIED for the PCR chip (softens ~73 C for general-purpose resin; PCR inhibition in every resin tested, so pcr_mix is marked incompatible). Not a wetted-surface material for culture either until leachate and cytotoxicity are tested: culture chips use it only as the print master that is hot-embossed into COC/COP/PMMA. Glass transition not sourced (null). Standard SLA/DLP resins soften around 45-75 C (heat deflection at 0.45 MPa) depending on resin and post-cure; high-temperature resins go much higher. Confirm for the exact resin.

coc.name: COC (TOPAS 5013 / 6013)
coc.grade_note: Not chosen. The 98 C PCR hold needs Tg well above 98 C: 5013 (134 C), 6013 (138-142 C), 6015 (158 C) or 6017 (178 C) qualify; 8007 (78 C), 9506 (64 C) and 7010 (110 C, too close) do not. glass_transition_c below is the working value for 5013.
coc.glass_transition_source: TOPAS Advanced Polymers, TOPAS COC product page (public): Tg per grade, 64 C (9506F-500) to 178 C (6017S-04): https://topas.com/products/topas-coc-polymers/
coc.optical_transparency: Optically clear, ~91-92% visible transmission, low autofluorescence; UV-transparent
coc.pcr_98c_status: SURVIVES 98 C PCR (Tg 134/138 C is well above 98 C)
coc.dna_adsorption: Low: hydrophobic, little DNA binding; protein/enzyme adsorption possible
coc.note: Tg ~134 C (5013) / ~138 C (6013) from the fabrication review. 120 C max working temperature is an ASSUMPTION (derated below Tg and the ~130 C heat deflection range; not a datasheet continuous-use figure). Excellent resistance to polar solvents, aqueous salts, acids and bases; attacked by non-polar hydrocarbons, so mineral oil is 'limited' (swelling, worse when hot). Compatibility verdicts are generic polymer-resistance expectations, NOT tested with our reagents: ASSUMPTION until checked. reagent_a..h are placeholders and stay TODO.

cop_zeonor_1420r.name: COP (Zeonor 1420R)
cop_zeonor_1420r.optical_transparency: Optically clear, ~91-92% visible transmission, very low autofluorescence; UV-transparent
cop_zeonor_1420r.dna_adsorption: Low: hydrophobic, little DNA binding; protein/enzyme adsorption possible
cop_zeonor_1420r.note: Tg ~136 C from the fabrication review. 120 C max working temperature is an ASSUMPTION (derated below Tg, not a datasheet continuous-use figure). Same chemistry class as COC: good against polar solvents and aqueous salts, swells in non-polar hydrocarbons (mineral oil 'limited'). Compatibility verdicts are generic polymer-resistance expectations, NOT tested with our reagents: ASSUMPTION until checked. reagent_a..h are placeholders and stay TODO.

cop_zeonor_1060r.name: COP (Zeonor 1060R)
cop_zeonor_1060r.optical_transparency: Optically clear, ~91-92% visible transmission, very low autofluorescence; UV-transparent
cop_zeonor_1060r.pcr_98c_status: DISQUALIFIED for the PCR chip: Tg ~100 C leaves no margin at 98 C and the part will creep and distort
cop_zeonor_1060r.dna_adsorption: Low: hydrophobic, little DNA binding; protein/enzyme adsorption possible
cop_zeonor_1060r.note: DISQUALIFIED for the PCR chip (Tg ~100 C; the 98 C hold is too close to it). Fine for 37 C culture chips. 90 C max working temperature is an ASSUMPTION chosen below Tg so tools/check_chip_spec.py rejects a 98 C hold. The bare aliases 'cop' and 'zeonor' (grade not given) deliberately resolve HERE, the worst case, so a PCR chip must name 'zeonor_1420r' to pass. Chemistry as COP 1420R. Compatibility verdicts are generic polymer-resistance expectations, NOT tested with our reagents: ASSUMPTION until checked. reagent_a..h are placeholders and stay TODO.

pdms.name: PDMS (silicone elastomer, e.g. Sylgard 184)
pdms.optical_transparency: Optically clear, >90% visible transmission; UV cutoff ~240 nm
pdms.pcr_98c_status: Survives 98 C thermally, but NOT recommended for the PCR chip: gas-permeable, so water vapour loss and bubbles at 98 C, and it absorbs primers and enzymes
pdms.dna_adsorption: Moderate: hydrophobic surface adsorbs DNA and small hydrophobic molecules, and absorbs them into the bulk
pdms.note: 200 C continuous service is the usual manufacturer figure (ASSUMPTION until checked against our exact product). Swells in ethanol and isopropanol and in hydrocarbon oils (mineral oil 'limited'); fluorinated oils swell it little and are the standard carrier for PDMS droplet chips. Cannot be hot-embossed; it is cast. Not used by any current chip spec. Compatibility verdicts are generic polymer-resistance expectations, NOT tested with our reagents: ASSUMPTION until checked. reagent_a..h are placeholders and stay TODO.

glass.name: Glass (borosilicate / soda-lime)
glass.optical_transparency: Optically clear, ~90-92% visible transmission; borosilicate UV cutoff ~310 nm
glass.pcr_98c_status: Survives 98 C thermally; suitable as a lid or base, but see DNA adsorption: poor as a wetted surface for the GuSCN lysis and PCR steps
glass.dna_adsorption: HIGH in 4 M guanidinium thiocyanate: silica binds DNA in chaotropic salt (the basis of silica-column purification); also adsorbs DNA and polymerase in PCR unless passivated
glass.note: 450 C is the long-term working temperature quoted for borosilicate (ASSUMPTION until checked for the exact glass). Chemically inert to everything we use, but DNA loss to the surface is real, so GuSCN and PCR are 'limited'. Cannot be hot-embossed or printed; used as a flat bonded lid or base. Not used by any current chip spec. Compatibility verdicts are generic polymer-resistance expectations, NOT tested with our reagents: ASSUMPTION until checked. reagent_a..h are placeholders and stay TODO.
